edits.rationale: The pinned OneUptime article (published 2026-03-31) has a 'Streaming Audit Events to a SIEM' script that polls /orgs/{ORG_ID}/events. It makes one request with itemsPerPage=500, reads only the results array, never requests further pages, and sets last_polled to the current time after forwarding. Events beyond 500 in a window, or created while a request is in flight, would therefore be skipped. That consequence is the analyst's inference from the code, not a defect the article or Atlas reports.

edits.old: Viewing the organization feed requires at least Organization Member; viewing the project feed requires at least Project Read Only. A September 2023 practitioner thread reported that assigning project read-only access also exposed organization-feed metadata through Organization Member membership. Treat organization-feed visibility as an IAM review consideration. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
